body.typeLabel: Accessible label of the control that chooses the body type.
body.editorLabel: Accessible label of the body editor.
body.format: Button that indents the body. Short.
body.formatTitle: {{type}} is JSON or XML, {{chord}} is a keyboard shortcut, {{example}} is the variable syntax of Gostman. Keep the last two as given.
body.cannotFormatAt: {{type}} is JSON or XML; {{message}} is a technical parser message in English.
body.cannotFormat: {{type}} is JSON or XML; {{message}} is a technical parser message in English.
body.goToLine: Link that moves the cursor to the line with the error.
body.noBody: Title of the empty state shown for body type None.
body.multipartOnGet: GET, POST and PUT are HTTP methods and stay in English.
body.replacedByGraphQL: GRAPHQL is a method name of Gostman and stays in English. GraphQL tab is an interface label.
body.types.none: Body type: the request has no body.
body.types.text: Body type: plain text. Not the same as the Text option of a form field.
body.types.file: Body type: the body is the content of one file.
